learning: Retain each timely episode's realized long midpoint return after signed funding even when cash was chosen. For future decisions use the last 28 eligible forecast errors already settled before the feature cutoff. After at least 12 such observations add their sum clipped individually to +/-2%, divided by count plus 24, to the base forecast. Preserve the original raw forecast to assess calibration. Missed and delayed episodes do not enter this correction.
execution: Use the six-hour BTC model without tuning features, labels or neighbors. Its historical stress-cost policy is kept as a control. For the prospective paper account estimate a round-trip hurdle from the existing WhiteBIT collector: sample one quote per five UTC minutes over the previous 24h and pair it with a same-generation quote 1 to 3 seconds later that displays at least 400 USDT on both sides. Charge twice the 95th percentile of the worse one-way cost against the earlier midpoint plus fees of 0.06% twice. Require at least 144 distinct sampled intervals, at least 24 covering the last four hours, and a fresh feed. On insufficient coverage keep cash. The calibration is prospective only.
sequence: Commit the direction and training examples before the UTC entry clock. Take a fresh public order book in the first five minutes after that clock for an actual paper execution. Close on the first fresh public book at or after six hours, retain the receipt, review chosen and opposite outcomes, and record the new settled capital. Missed entries remain missing. A delayed close is marked separately. One virtual account, no simultaneous positions and no paid model calls. No automatic real orders.
